2348-3688-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-3688-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1003-1591-2459-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.

1003-1591-2459-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

215-527-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5686-7084-7705.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3668.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Flesh Duplicate dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Flesh Duplicate that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Flesh Duplicate token instead.
2523-2869-3668.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

703-2665-7149.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Progenitor Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Progenitor Mimic enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Progenitor Mimics into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Progenitor Mimic tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-2665-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

24-4090-5356.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Barbed Servitor instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Barbed Servitor triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt.
24-4090-5356.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

3532-3594-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1594-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.

3234-3293-5414-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5414-5686.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5414-5686.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4089-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 2.

132-2645-6700.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sarevok's Tome's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-6700.notes: You can instead use Sarevok's Tome's second ability if mana allows.

136-1719-2628-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
136-1719-2628-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Cadaver Imp.
When Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1808-2921-3000.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2440-4050-5220-6456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Dragons, one of which must be nontoken and have mana value 8 or less.
2440-4050-5220-6456.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 8 or less, adding {R}.
When the Dragon dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the Dragon from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Breaching Dragonstorm by paying {4}{R}.
When Breaching Dragonstorm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to exile the Dragon from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Breaching Dragonstorm's second ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Breaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Dragon you control.
Repeat.

277-880-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-5702.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2440-2797.manaNeeded: {2} plus up to {10} additional depending on the number of Servos you control
2440-2797.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers.
If you control less than three Servos, activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
If you control less than three Servos, repeat from step 1 until you control three Servos.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo you control for each trigger.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Repeat from step 6.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities.

3403-3489-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Infiltrator does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
3403-3489-3542.description:
Declare Ingenious Infiltrator as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Ingenious Infiltrator from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ingenious Infiltrator's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ingenious Infiltrator onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1261-1304-4916.description:

Activate Nature's Chosen by paying {0}, untapping Time Vault.
Repeat each turn.

638-1170-2093-4074.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
If you cast the spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chandra.
Cast Lapse of Certainty by paying {2}{W}, targeting that spell.
Chandra, Displacer Kitten and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Lapse of Certainty, targeting the original Lapse of Certainty.
Resolve the copy of Lapse of Certainty, countering the original Lapse of Certainty and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Lapse of Certainty without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 4.

539-1339-2232-3848-4336.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-1339-2232-3848-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Omnath's second ability.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

389-4053.description:
If a source would deal damage to you, Nine Lives prevents that damage.
Solmenity prevents Nine Lives from putting an incarnation counter on itself.

4222-5089-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
4222-5089-5116.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Gilded Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
